John Howley, Treasurer
John Howley began serving as the Pickaway County Treasurer in 2025. As the County Treasurer, he is charged with the collection of all real property taxes and manufactured homes taxes. The treasurer also is the Chief Investment Official for the county and holds the highest bond among all other county officials. The treasurer serves as the chair of the County Investment Advisory Board and is a statutory member of the Board of Revision, the Budget Commission and the Data Processing Board.
Real estate and manufactured home taxes may be paid in person, by mail or by credit card via the office’s website ( https://picktreasurer.org/ (opens in a new window on an external website) ). The Treasurer’s Office is open Monday through Friday from 8:15 a.m. until 4 p.m.
